'''Ragon''' was a soldier from the [[Borderlands]]. He fought in [[Lan Mandragoran]]'s army.

== Activities ==
Ragon fights in the Borderlander army in the [[Last Battle]] at [[Tarmon Gai'don]]. He charges his horse into a group of thirty [[Trolloc]]s that were about to hit the a group of men unnoticed. Ragon saves most of the men with his heroic deed, including [[Andere]], but is killed in the process. {{ref|{{twotc}}, Ragon}} 

{{quote|Yes, Ragon was a right insane man," Andere said. "I'm one of the men he saved." He smiled. "He did die well. Light, but he did. |Andere, another soldier from the Borderlands {{ref/book|14|9}}}}

==Trivia==
Ragon is named for Bryan Ragon, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
